summary.text: Nancy Mitchell is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Belknap 7, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Mitchell earned a bachelor's degree from Granite State College, according to Ballotpedia, and in a Ballotpedia survey said she is excited about renewable energy solutions.
